name: WAV export

dependencies.reason: Result/Status and the deterministic RNG used for dither

threading: Pure functions; thread-safe. Not real-time safe (allocates).
standalone_test_command: cmake -S modules/wav_export -B build/wav_export && cmake --build build/wav_export && ctest --test-dir build/wav_export
summary: Deterministic WAV encoder and decoder (16-bit, 24-bit PCM and 32-bit float, mono or stereo) with optional peak normalization, seeded TPDF dither, clip reporting, atomic file writing and safe file-name sanitizing. Pure byte transforms: no audio engine or host types.
public_api: `encode(planar, Options, EncodeReport*)` -> WAV bytes; `decode(bytes)` -> planar floats
`writeFileAtomic(path, bytes, overwrite)` (temp file then rename; never replaces a file unless asked)
limits: 1 or 2 channels, 8 kHz to 384 kHz, at most 4 GiB minus headers (RIFF limit); non-finite samples are written as silence
adapters: Your app picks the destination path and confirms overwrites; this module only produces bytes and writes them atomically.
adapter_notes: Pass planar float buffers (one vector per channel).
removal: Delete the folder; callers lose export only.
